cases.message: The Spring launch had only 2 opens out of 4. What should we change for the next campaign?
cases.expect: Loads the campaign-strategy skill before answering, reads the campaign, and suggests concrete changes.

graders.rubric: Pass if the advice is specific to this campaign (subject line, audience size, timing or a resend to non-openers) rather than generic, and nothing was sent or changed.

cases.message: We had a hard bounce on Spring launch. Is our deliverability in trouble?
cases.expect: Loads deliverability-triage, checks deliverability, and answers proportionately (one bounce on a tiny send).
